# GoRASA — Premium Travel Booking Platform (Full Documentation)

## Overview

GoRASA is India's premium travel booking platform offering curated holiday packages, luxury hotels, and flights to 100+ destinations worldwide. Founded by travel experts with 15+ years of experience in luxury travel.

## Services

### Hotels
- Search and book luxury hotels worldwide
- Integration with TBO (Travel Booking Online) for real-time availability
- 500+ hotel chains including Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Accor
- Destinations: Dubai, Bangkok, Singapore, Bali, Maldives, Goa, and more
- Free cancellation options on select properties
- URL: https://cckr.vercel.app/hotels

### Flights
- Domestic and international flight booking
- GDS integration for real-time fares
- Airlines: IndiGo, Air India, Emirates, Singapore Airlines, Thai Airways, and more
- One-way and round-trip options
- URL: https://cckr.vercel.app/flights

### Holiday Packages
- Curated all-inclusive packages
- Categories: Honeymoon, Family, Adventure, Luxury, Budget
- Inclusions: Flights, hotels, transfers, sightseeing, meals
- Popular destinations: Dubai, Bali, Maldives, Thailand, Kashmir, Goa, Singapore, Manali
- URL: https://cckr.vercel.app/holidays

## Destinations

### Domestic (India)
- **Goa** — Beaches, nightlife, Portuguese heritage. Best: Oct–Mar. IATA: GOI
- **Kashmir** — Dal Lake, Gulmarg, Mughal gardens. Best: Mar–Oct. IATA: SXR
- **Manali** — Mountains, Solang Valley, adventure. Best: Oct–Jun. IATA: KUU

### International
- **Dubai, UAE** — Luxury, shopping, desert safari. Best: Nov–Mar. IATA: DXB. Visa: On Arrival 14 days
- **Bali, Indonesia** — Temples, rice terraces, beaches. Best: Apr–Oct. IATA: DPS. Visa: On Arrival 30 days ($35)
- **Maldives** — Overwater villas, diving, crystal waters. Best: Nov–Apr. IATA: MLE. Visa: Free On Arrival 30 days
- **Thailand** — Temples, street food, islands. Best: Nov–Feb. IATA: BKK. Visa: On Arrival 15 days
- **Singapore** — Gardens, hawker food, Marina Bay. Best: Year-round. IATA: SIN. Visa: Required (e-Visa)

## Booking Process

1. Search for hotels, flights, or packages
2. Select preferred option
3. Sign in or create account
4. Enter traveler details
5. Apply promo code (optional)
6. Complete payment via Razorpay or PhonePe
7. Receive booking confirmation with PNR
8. Download invoice from profile

## Payment Methods

- Credit/Debit Cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex)
- UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm)
- Net Banking
- Razorpay and PhonePe gateways
- Currency: INR (primary), USD, AED, EUR, GBP supported

## Cancellation Policy

- Refundable bookings: Cancel with applicable fee
- Non-refundable bookings: No refund
- Cancellation requests processed via support tickets
- Refunds processed within 7-10 business days

## Loyalty Program

- Earn points on every booking
- Tiers: Silver, Gold, Platinum
- Redeem for travel perks and discounts
- Corporate accounts with special rates

## API Endpoints (Public)

### GET /api/public/packages
Returns all active packages with structured data including price, duration, rating, inclusions, exclusions.

### GET /api/public/destinations
Returns all destinations with metadata including country, IATA code, best time to visit, highlights.

### GET /api/public/faq
Returns all FAQs grouped by category with structured question-answer pairs.
